description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Computer Organisation and Architecture topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: coa

facts.claim: Control unit, arithmetic unit, memory and I/O

source.quote: A central control unit to sequence operations performed by the machine

facts.claim: Memory stores both data and instructions

source.quote: Memory that stores data and instructions

facts.claim: Fetch, decode, execute

source.quote: It is composed of three main stages: the fetch stage, the decode stage, and the execute stage

facts.claim: The instruction register holds the instruction being decoded

source.quote: is where the instruction is temporarily held, for the CPU to decode it

facts.claim: Addressing modes say how an instruction finds its operand

source.quote: Addressing modes define how the machine language instructions in that architecture identify the operand(s) of each instruction

facts.claim: They compute the effective address

source.quote: An addressing mode specifies how to calculate the effective memory address of an operand

facts.claim: Two's complement: invert the bits and add one

source.quote: inverting gives all ones, and adding one changes the ones back to zeros

facts.claim: One zero; n bits range −2ⁿ⁻¹ … 2ⁿ⁻¹ − 1 (4 bits: −8 … +7)

source.quote: the two's complement scheme has only one representation for zero

facts.claim: Sign, significand (mantissa) and exponent

source.quote: s = a sign (zero or one), c = a significand (also called a coefficient or mantissa)

facts.claim: Normalised significand has an implicit leading 1

source.quote: this bit is not explicitly stored in the representation, but is left implicit

facts.claim: Booth's algorithm multiplies signed two's complement numbers

source.quote: Booth's multiplication algorithm is a multiplication algorithm that multiplies two signed binary numbers in two's complement notation

facts.claim: It examines pairs of adjacent bits (with an extra bit Q₋₁)

source.quote: Booth's algorithm examines adjacent pairs of bits of the N-bit multiplier

facts.claim: Microcode: low-level instructions that implement the instruction set

source.quote: microcode is a layer of low-level control data or instructions used to implement a processor's instruction set architecture

facts.claim: The control unit turns an instruction into internal actions

source.quote: Converting a single instruction read from memory into the sequence of internal actions is the duty of the control unit

facts.claim: DMA lets devices access memory without the CPU

source.quote: allows certain hardware subsystems to access main system memory independently of the central processing unit

facts.claim: The CPU starts the transfer and gets an interrupt when it is done

source.quote: it finally receives an interrupt from the direct memory access controller

facts.claim: Pipelining gives instruction-level parallelism by overlapping stages

source.quote: instruction pipelining is a technique for implementing instruction-level parallelism within a single processor

facts.claim: It increases throughput (not the latency of one instruction)

source.quote: Pipelining typically reduces the processor's cycle time and increases the throughput of instructions

facts.claim: Data, structural and control hazards

source.quote: Three common types of hazards are data hazards, structural hazards, and control hazards

facts.claim: Structural hazard: two instructions need the same resource

source.quote: A structural hazard occurs when two (or more) instructions which are already in a pipeline need the same resource

facts.claim: Higher levels are smaller and faster

source.quote: each member mi is typically smaller and faster than the next highest member

facts.claim: Direct-mapped: each block has exactly one place

source.quote: if each entry in the main memory can go in just one place in the cache, the cache is direct-mapped

facts.claim: N-way set associative: any one of N places

source.quote: are described as N-way set associative
